content:
Sahil: FYI I've opened a PR to add the pulumi/terraform wiring for ap-southeast-2-gpu (new AZ cluster). PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infrastructure/pull/612. Need quick eyes on state/backend, CI wiring, and GPU quota numbers before I merge.

Marta: looking now. can you confirm where pulumi state is hosted and the lifecycle for tfstate? also want the exact SA used by CI.

Sahil: Pulumi state -> gs://redwood-pulumi-states-apse-gpu2 (kms: projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/pulumi). Terraform remote state -> gs://tfstate-redwood-apse-gpu2 bucket. CI SA is infra-ci@redwood-prod.

Cheng: re: locking — GCS doesn't have native locks, we rely on object generation + a small lock file plus CI serial check. Pulumi uses its own state locking via the service account. Recommend adding a Dynamo-style lock? alternatively enable object versioning + precondition checks.

Priya: quota note: cloud quota for GPUs in that region currently caps at 64 A100s. We opened a quota request (ticket #Q-421) for +128 on 2026-03-01, approval pending. Until approved, we should plan for mixed instance pools and fallback to smaller SKUs.

Sahil: noted — PR adds an autoscaler profile that prefers 8xA100 nodes but has fallback to 16xA10x8 nodes. We'll gate the rollout behind a capacity smoke test.

Ops-Eng: quick checklist suggestion so we don't miss anything during handoff:
- confirm state bucket permissions and rotation
- CI pipeline: terraform plan + pulumi preview as separate steps
- cloud SA roles verified (storage admin, kms encrypter, compute.viewer, compute.admin for fleet creation)
- vpc peering + shared services routes tested
- quota + quota fallback documented
- alerting dashboards and paging rules ready

Marta: adding inline — CI snippet to run locally for validation:
```
export GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS=~/.gcloud/infra-ci.json
terraform init -backend-config="bucket=tfstate-redwood-apse-gpu2"
terraform plan -var-file=ap-se2.vars.tfvars
pulumi preview --non-interactive --stack redwood/ap-se2-gpu
```
Run that from a clean environment to ensure remote state and secrets access are correct.

Cheng: network gotcha we hit in another region: subnet secondary ranges must be pre-created for GKE node pools when using VPC-native. Add a validation step: `gcloud compute networks subnets describe <subnet> --region=ap-southeast-2` and verify secondary CIDR usage. Also ensure the route table for shared services is replicated.

Sahil: good catch. I added a `validate_networking.sh` script in the PR which checks subnets, routes, and peering status — simple `gcloud` checks plus a `curl` to the shared metadata endpoint to validate connectivity.

infra-bot: CI pipeline triggered for PR #612 — plan succeeded (terraform-plan: ok), pulumi-preview: had a warning about serviceAccount impersonation. See CI link: https://ci.internal/redwood/612

Priya: about cost — Ops requested estimating unit-cost: this config ~0.72 $/token-hour on A100. If we shift to q8_0 quant profile and batch tuning we can drop ~25-30% per-token cost. add Optimize recommendations to the runbook.

Ops-Eng: handoff steps I'd like in the final runbook (to be included in the PR description):
- State migration doc + who ran it + timestamp
- Post-merge run: `terraform apply` in staging then `pulumi up` in canary account
- Capacity smoke test: spin up 10 nodes, run perf job (ref: runbooks/perf/gpu-smoke.md)
- Observability: dashboards live, token-level cost seen in Console, alerting tested with `ops-testalert`
- Ownership: oncall week assigned (Sahil week of 2026-03-15), pager duty update

Marta: I'll do a permissions pass and sanity-check the bucket encryption and IAM. Cheng can you validate network script? Priya please follow up on quota ticket and post ETA. I'll leave comments on the PR for tweaks.

Cheng: will validate networking and run the smoke perf job once PR merged to staging.

Priya: quota ticket updated — asked support for expedited review, ETA 48-72h. posting updates in #cloud-quotas.

Sahil: thanks all — I'll incorporate the checklist into the PR description, add the Optimize notes, and mark the PR as `do-not-merge` until quota is resolved or fallback validated. Planning handoff meeting Thursday 09:30 PT to go through the runbook and owners.

Ops-Eng: :thumbsup: schedule works. When this is merged, add a short migration note to infra-runbooks/regions with the final bucket names and the `apply` commands used.

infra-bot: reminder — please add CHANGELOG entry to `infra-changelog/2026-03.md` with region and PR link.

Sahil: done — pushed CHANGELOG entry and updated PR. merging blocked until quota or fallback validated. Thanks for the quick reviews.

Priya: I'll post quota approval or fallback confirmation in this thread once I have it.

Marta: review complete, two minor comments left in PR. after those we should be good to run staging.

Sahil: addressing comments now. will ping when staging apply is complete.
